tools.name: check_rotation
tools.description: Check a beekeeper's varroa treatment history against published resistance-rotation guidance. Deterministic rules only — no AI. Returns violations (same active group repeated, label withdrawal period breached), cautions, and the inputs it could not judge.

tools.name: list_active_groups
tools.description: The active-group table this service rotates on: product, active ingredient, and IRAC mode-of-action group. Cite the group number when you record a treatment.

tools.name: get_thresholds
tools.description: Published varroa damage thresholds with their exact source, plus the monitoring cadence the guidance asks for. Quoted study values — not a recommendation.
